stem: Which statement about f(x) = 4x² - 36x + 81 is true?

options.label: A
options.text: The zeros are \frac{3}{4} and -27 because f(x) = (4x - 3)(x - 27).

options.label: B
options.text: The zeros are -\frac{3}{2} and \frac{27}{2} because f(x) = (2x + 3)(2x + 27).

options.label: D
options.text: The only zero is \frac{9}{2} because f(x) = (2x - 9)^{2}.
